## Real-HTML demos are the free plan here.

Capturing the actual HTML of your product, rather than screenshots of it, is the feature most evaluations turn on. Everywhere else it sits behind a $450+/mo tier or an enterprise quote. [...] Tours as code, verified in CI

Read the MCP docs

```
> /rendemo:launch-checklist Checkout flow · 9 steps captured 9 captions written brand kit applied across 9 steps hero moments punched in 0 findings email gate on step 7 publish to the world? y

Rendemo ships a built-in MCP server, so Claude Code, Claude.ai, or any MCP-compatible agent can produce, improve and ship interactive demos end to end — without leaving the editor.

One prompt, capture to published

Connects in one command
